summary: A seven branch Doha dental group appears to lose patients to Arabic only proof on the English site, scattered phone numbers and a stale footer.

findings.problem: The English Patient Testimonials section appears to show Arabic text only.
findings.cost: English speaking patients cannot read the proof meant to win them.
findings.fix: Translated testimonials on the English pages.

findings.problem: The contact page appears to list up to three numbers per branch, with one number repeated across branches.
findings.cost: Patients do not know which line to call and may give up.
findings.fix: One booking line per branch and a single main number.

findings.problem: The page appears to claim 25+ years, 30+ doctors and 1000+ weekly visits, with no ratings or review count shown.
findings.cost: Big numbers without a review source are easy to doubt.
findings.fix: A visible review rating linked to its source.

findings.cost: An old year suggests the site is not kept up to date.

redesign: One clear booking line per branch.
Visible ratings and a current footer.
